message.content:
(1) Overall layout structure: MATCH. Both use a 3-pane layout (sidebar, file list, details/preview) with a centered modal overlay.
(2) Information architecture: MATCH. Both display scan results in a modal with file counts and size, followed by a primary action button.
(3) Color palette family: MATCH. Both utilize a light theme with a blue primary color for CTAs and neutral grays for backgrounds.
(4) Typography scale: MATCH. Both use a large bold title for the status, medium-sized numbers for stats, and smaller text for labels.
(5) Control geometry: DIFF. Image 1 uses a 2-column grid for stats; Image 2 uses a 2x2 grid and includes "Time used" and "Unreadable areas."
(6) Primary CTA placement: MATCH. In both images, the primary CTA is centered at the bottom of the modal dialog.

VERDICT: STRUCTURALLY_EQUIVALENT. While the internal arrangement of statistics within the modal differs slightly, the overall spatial organization, component hierarchy, and visual language are consistent.
